contexts.about: Every section of this toolkit points toward one outcome: reducing suicidal ideation in the youth Rise serves. Use it to keep each session focused on that goal.
contexts.planner: Every step of this planner works toward one outcome: reducing the client's suicidal ideation. Map, prioritize, and plan around what drives it and what protects against it.
contexts.safetyPlan: A safety plan helps the client get through moments of suicidal ideation safely, and gives you a shared tool for reducing it over time.
contexts.library: Every resource here is selected for its role in reducing youth suicidal ideation: assessing it, coping with it, or building the supports that protect against it.
contexts.referral: Reductions in suicidal ideation last when care continues. Linking the client to their next step helps protect the progress made in treatment.
contexts.schools: School connectedness is one of the strongest protectors against youth suicidal ideation. Strong school partnerships help keep the client safe and supported where they spend most of their day.
